if(NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 4)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "The vendored MinHook libraries are x86 only.")
endif()
add_library(minhook STATIC IMPORTED GLOBAL)
set_target_properties(minhook PROPERTIES
    IMPORTED_CONFIGURATIONS "RELEASE;DEBUG"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/lib/minhook-x86-release.lib"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/lib/minhook-x86-release.lib"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_DEBUG "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/lib/minhook-x86-debug.lib"
    MAP_IMPORTED_CONFIG_RELWITHDEBINFO RELEASE
    MAP_IMPORTED_CONFIG_MINSIZEREL RELEASE
    INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/include")
